purpose: Teach: ダブル/ショット/直感/展覧/演じる/細い/逃げる/助ける

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、ダブル、絶対、サイズの、絶対、お酒、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm serious—I definitely saw Dad buying a huge bottle of sake at the festival.
lines.style: Rapid-fire, proud discovery spilling out. Breathy with excitement. Emphasizes 'serious' and 'definitely' like he's reporting something important he witnessed. Childlike precision.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんが、本気で、絶対、お祭りの、絶対、ショット、絶対、撮ってくれたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad really did take some great shots at the festival, didn't he, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused recall. Soft, conversational—not lecturing. A mother's quiet acknowledgment that she saw what he saw. Gentle landing at his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、直感、絶対、で、絶対、お友達を選ぶよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm being serious—I choose my friends by instinct, you know.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Carefully chosen words, like he's explaining something true he's noticed about himself. No bravado, just fact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度の、本気で、絶対、展覧、絶対、会、絶対、家族で、絶対、行きましょう、翔くん
lines.en: Next time there's an exhibition, let's go as a family, okay Sho.
lines.style: Gentle, inviting proposal. Warm forward movement in the voice. The phrasing feels like an offer, not an announcement. Soft emphasis on 'as a family.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、運動会で、絶対、リーダーを、絶対、演じる、絶対、んだ
lines.en: Mom, I'm serious—I'm going to be a leader at the sports day, you know.
lines.style: Quiet pride and resolve. Speaks matter-of-factly, like he's already decided this about himself. No uncertainty, but no boasting either. Steady.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、細い、絶対、わよ、ちゃんと、ご飯食べてね
lines.en: Sho, I've noticed you're looking a bit thin lately. Make sure you're eating properly, okay.
lines.style: Observant, caring concern. Not alarmed, but attentive—the voice of someone who watches closely. Ends with gentle instruction, not worry. Maternal steadiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、難しいこと、絶対、から、絶対、逃げる、絶対、ように、絶対、しないよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm being serious—I'm not going to run away from hard things.
lines.style: Determined whisper-strength. Each word matters. Not defiant, but resolute—like he's telling himself as much as her. Small, genuine commitment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、ご近所の方を、絶対、助ける、絶対、こと、絶対、続けていきましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's keep helping the people around us, okay. That's important.
lines.style: Warm, close guidance. The tone of someone passing something true to someone she trusts will listen. Steady, not urgent. Quiet pride underneath.
